question: As per the recent NFHS-5 (2019-21) report, what percentage of children under the age of five are underweight in our country?
solution:
The correct answer is __**32.1%.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

 
• As per the NFHS-5 (2019-21) report, **32.1% (0.321)** of children under the age of five in India are classified as underweight.
 
• The percentage reflects children whose weight-for-age is below the standard deviation set by the World Health Organization (WHO) growth standards.
